title: LearnerStageResult
description: An untargeted learner result against a unit/stage. Context only: it carries no credit, mastery, or requirement semantics, and authoring a requirement target later never retro-credits it.

unit.description: Owning unit id; with stage it names one current study-map stage.

stage.description: Stage id within the unit's current study map.

note.description: Free-text note about this attempt. Prose only; never evidence.

conditions.description: Condition labels the learner states held for this attempt. Labels only: without a requirement target there is nothing to interpret them against.
